summary: Marketing is laser-focused on propelling Asia Star and Intelligent China as top program priorities, with urgent execution on SEO, content, and event logistics this week.
summaryDetail: The team is prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China in all marketing efforts, with SEO strategy and audience profiling underway to boost visibility for AI, EV, and smart manufacturing topics. This week, immediate attention is needed on resolving the Outlook login issue to restore team communication, and on scheduling feedback sessions for the knowledge website redesign to finalize improvements. Upcoming deadlines include finalizing the CKGSB-IE report with the new cover, sending the monthly newsletter mid-month, and coordinating Dean Xiang's participation in the TIA luncheon. Concurrently, content production for Asia Start videos and the newsletter template revamp are in progress, while the team prepares for the China Going-Global report launch and Tech in Asia booth design.
